tools.name: ask
tools.description: Entry point for any question about taxis and travel from Quy Nhon to Da Nang (Quang Ngai centre). Classifies the question (fare, trip estimate, routes, places, lodging, guides, FAQ, booking) and returns data from the matching source with confidence and suggested next tools. Read-only.

tools.name: get_booking_info
tools.description: How to book a Taxi Xanh SM ride in Quang Ngai and nearby (Quy Nhon to Da Nang): hotline, Zalo, Messenger, app links, operating hours. Read-only.

tools.name: get_fare_table
tools.description: Reference taxi fares by service: per-km tiers, surcharges and notes, in VND. Omit service to get all services. Prices are reference values. Read-only.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search published travel guides and news about Quang Ngai and nearby (beaches, islands, food, hotels directories). Accent-insensitive. 10 results per page. Read-only.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Full article as Markdown, split into parts of about 6000 characters; use part to read the rest. Read-only.

tools.name: search_faq
tools.description: Frequently asked questions about rides, payment, safety, app accounts and driver sign-up. Accent-insensitive. Up to 10 results. Read-only.

tools.name: estimate_trip_cost
tools.description: Estimate a taxi fare in VND from distance_km, or from/to matching a popular route, using listed fare tiers. Returns a reference range per service. Read-only.

tools.name: list_popular_routes
tools.description: Popular taxi routes (airport, ports, beaches, cities from Quy Nhon to Da Nang) with distance, duration and reference prices. Filter by area. Read-only.

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Verified places to visit, eat or transfer (beaches, islands, historic sites, ports, airports) in the Quy Nhon to Da Nang area. Accent-insensitive. Read-only.

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Details of a verified place: description as Markdown, opening hours, ticket price, map link. Read-only.

tools.name: search_lodging
tools.description: Operating hotels, guesthouses and homestays with phone, website and reference room prices (with survey date; prices change often). Filter by area, type, stars, max price. Read-only.
